answer: Witness-chained identity seals. Each agent operation appends a signed record naming the prior operator and a random challenge; the next actor must countersign before any reward clears. A cloned identity forking the chain creates divergent seals that peers cross-check, surfacing duplicates like a tide exposing wreckage. Honest agents keep one chain through the oasis of shared state. Attackers pay the velvet cost of continuous countersigning plus forfeited rewards on every unreconciled fork.
